summary.name: Chromium
summary.one_liner: Chromium is the open-source browser project behind Google Chrome, and this site holds its developer documentation for working with the source code.
use_cases: Learning to build and run Chromium from source
Contributing code to the Chromium project
Reporting bugs or security issues in Chromium
Reading design docs and architecture overviews
Debugging Chromium on Windows, OS X, Linux or Android
summary.what_it_does: The page is the landing page for the Chromium project's documentation site. It describes Chromium as an open-source browser project aimed at a safer, faster, and more stable web experience. It links to guides on browsing and searching the sources online, checking out, building and running the code, and contributing code. Sections cover getting involved, developer design docs, testing and bug reporting guidelines, user experience philosophy, issue tracking, contact, security, privacy, and events. It also points to a slide deck called Life Of A Chromium Developer as a starting crash course.
notable: Official documentation hub for the Chromium source code that Google Chrome is built on
Includes design docs, architecture overviews, and test plans
Life Of A Chromium Developer slide deck for newcomers
caveats: Page is developer-oriented documentation and does not describe an end-user browser download
